does_not_cover: Never computes a test statistic or distribution: the 0.24 and 0.04 values arrive asserted.
No z or t procedure, no intervals, no power or sample-size planning.
Categorical, rank and multiplicity methods untouched despite the testing title.
notes: Story-driven pace; no formulas required. The drug framing is illustrative and non-technical throughout.

Lopsided large table versus ambiguous split motivating quantification
Threshold question and the conventional 0.05 meaning
Same-drug repeat runs explaining false positives and threshold choice
Testing vocabulary plus the effect-size warning with contrasting cases

teaches.why: Grounds the 0.05 cutoff in repeat-experiment error rates with demos.
Shows false positives arising under no effect and cost-based threshold shifts.
